FAQs
Ask Away. We've Heard it All.

Can GenStone be used around fireplaces?

Yes. Many homeowners install GenStone panels to create fireplace surrounds and accent walls. Clearances and installation details should always follow the fireplace manufacturer’s recommendations and our rule of thumb: if you can place your hand on the installation surface for 5 seconds while the unit is running and no flames are embers will come in contact with the panels, you’re good to go.

Ellie Peretz

Assistant Manager

How realistic do GenStone panels look?

GenStone panels are cast from real stone molds to replicate natural textures and shadow lines. Once installed, most people cannot tell the difference between GenStone and traditional masonry.

Evan Trevenna

Senior Project Coordinator

Can GenStone panels be installed over drywall?

Yes. GenStone panels can typically be installed directly over drywall for interior projects as long as the wall structure is sound. Panels are attached to wall studs or other secure mounting points.

Brian Cassel

Senior Project Coordinator

Can I install GenStone panels myself?

Yes. GenStone panels are specifically designed for DIY installation. Many homeowners complete projects like accent walls, fireplaces, and garage facades without hiring a contractor.

Amanda Lombard

Director
